principles: No single aggregate Fig1 score; predictive rank/classification, exact amplitude, AIC, effect size and relation structure remain separate.
Biological unit is animal/fish/worm/donor where available; cells are never promoted to independent n.
Every inferential P names its randomization/permutation unit separately from aggregation unit.
Published-native reproduction and GAP standardized analysis are separate evidence layers.
Current figures use the 2026-10-05 plotting authority: Arial, square-ish panels, red focal evidence, cyan guardrail/secondary coordinate, gray baselines, no grid.
